data.description: A crystal-edged sword carried by the most faithful of the Captain's echoes. The command seals along its spine still answer him, turning a measure of every blow into a brief ward of glass.
A concentrated restorative sealed for the Ghost Ship's longest night watches. The medicine is still potent, though the crew it was brewed for has long since gone still.
